verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's VC practice page explicitly states it advises 'high-growth companies' as well as 'angel investors, equity and debt funds, corporate investors, incubators, accelerators and funding platforms,' directly confirming both-sides-of-the-table expertise, and separately claims market-leading deal volume and 'intimate familiarity with market deal terms, structures and trends' across the full spectrum of VC work. Missing for 10: independent rankings/testimonials specific to VC practice and concrete examples of acting on opposing sides of the same deal type.
